items.title: How Thailand Is Trying to Win Back Chinese Tourists
items.summary: Thailand is shifting from reassurance to access, betting that easier travel and deeper ties with China's interior will restore Chinese arrivals before rivals like Malaysia turn their gains into lasting market share.

items.title: Ari Emanuel Is Assembling a Live Tourism Conglomerate
items.summary: The companies that originate trips do not need to call themselves travel companies to capture travel's economics, and Ari Emanuel is demonstrating it across three of them.

items.title: Airbnb Partners With CarTrawler for Car Rentals in 5 Countries: Scoop
items.summary: Airbnb's partnership with CarTrawler on car rentals is Airbnb's latest step toward becoming a traditional online travel agency. CarTrawler is poised to become an Expedia brand, which will compete with Airbnb on car rentals.

items.title: The Travel Industry Was Banking on a World Cup Windfall. Here’s What the Numbers Show.
items.summary: The World Cup delivered real, rate-driven gains for hotels and short-term rentals. But the impact was barely noticed by U.S. airlines, and the international visitor boom is falling short of expectations.

items.title: Europe May Finally Charge International Flights for Emissions — U.S. and China Get a Pass
items.summary: Associations are unhappy with Europe’s plans to make the aviation industry pay more for its international emissions — for different reasons. One side argues proposals don’t go far enough, and the other says they shouldn’t exist at all.

items.title: The World Cup Travel Matrix
items.summary: Who lifted the trophy for the travel industry's World Cup? Behold Skift's winners, losers, floppers, and the freeloaders.

items.title: Allegiant, Long an OTA Holdout, Signs an Exclusive Deal With Expedia
items.summary: A shrinking number of airlines shun online travel agency distribution. Allegiant's deal with Expedia Group means it abandoned its direct-distribution-only strategy — one that it touted as advantageous as late as February 2026.
